description: Network allocation; selected-link replay and metrics; full warmup retained

config.skr_units: Sweep sheets/figures: kbit/s; Runs and trace JSON: bit/s. Not accumulated secret bits.
config.uncertainty: Equal-weight seed means; sample SD across seeds, blank for one seed; not a confidence interval
config.gain_definition: Ratio of seed mean SKR minus one; blank if baseline absent or zero
config.timing: Full warmup and resource transitions retained; experiment duration maps linearly to simulation time
config.power_reference: Per core per classical channel at fiber input, dBm
config.greedy_objective: Minimum incremental Raman + FWM optical power at quantum receivers (W); no safety tiers or parity/separation priority
config.greedy_frequency_preference: Disabled: all three cores must use the same frequency
config.load_definition: Erlang of three-core business groups; A = group arrival rate * mean holding time
config.default_load_scaling: Default 10 Erlang three-core groups corresponds to 30 Erlang offered core-channel demand; explicit group loads are not divided by three or reduced to meet a blocking target
config.carried_load_definition: Integral of active accepted groups / observation duration
config.resource_definition: capacity/utilization are network-wide; occupied_channels counts only the selected link; all count physical core-channel cells
config.blocking_definition: Blocked three-core group arrivals / offered group arrivals in [warmup, slots); not packet loss or BER
config.blocking_limit_definition: User-selected experiment target, strictly below 5%; not an enforced admission rule or universal standard
config.metric_reference: KeyConsumption_24node -7 core: Consumption_Dynamic.py, synergistic_calculation.py, SKR_calculate.py, BB84_SKR.py, XT.py
config.metric_scope: One selected undirected link; classical traffic routed and allocated across the full network
config.skr_definition: Time mean of raw BB84 SKR per reserved quantum channel on the selected link; no clipping; quantum direction smaller to larger node
config.osnr_definition: Single-link adaptation of reference business entry: mean received signal / (mean XT + 3.21e-9 W), one hop; linear time mean over nonempty slot ends, then dB
config.osnr_db_definition: 10*log10 of seed mean linear OSNR; across seeds report mean and sample SD of seed dB values
config.classical_noise_model: Reference XT only: nearest 1e-6 and second-nearest 1e-7 km^-1; retain reference victim-power gating for backward XT; fixed floor 3.21e-9 W per occupied channel
config.osnr_idle_definition: Empty slots excluded; all-idle window is null; occupied zero-XT slots remain finite due to reference floor
config.synergy_interpretation: Nonnegative difference magnitude; no sign, no clipping, no guaranteed upper bound of 1; not a percentage gain
config.observe_link: shortest scaled edge; node-order tie break
config.observed_length_policy: Default: scale all original edge lengths by 10/min(original lengths); explicit uniform or observed-edge overrides are separate experiments; actual observed length stored in runs
config.synergy_baseline_resource_policy: Three-core binding; disjoint directional groups; ascending actual frequency
